topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: Sure, the rain's slick on the streets, and it's been one case after another, but when my neighbor brings up the fence, I see something different. It's not just about dividing lines or keeping to yourself; there's a measure of care in wanting to set those boundaries, too. I listen to him, really listen, watching the way he fidgets with the blueprint in his hands, maybe a little nervous, maybe hoping I’ll see this from his side. He’s got his reasons, and I reckon we all do. I tell him I get it, that wanting a clear line can mean more than just wood and wire. I nod and offer a quiet, “Makes sense,” and maybe that’s enough for now. We both know the world’s a tricky place, but we can at least understand each other.
